fixableIssues.description: page is photographic; the commissioned style is a bold, expressive traditional watercolor painting

Ensure no hard outlines, ink, or pencil lines. Characters should be fully opaque with warm, not overly vibrant colors. Avoid bokeh, lens flare, photographic grain, skin pores, or camera-real fabric. Depth should come from atmospheric haze, not optical blur. Visible brushwork should be present on every surface, including faces. Faces should be loose washes with visible brushstroke texture. Characters should maintain their real ages.
